messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need a quick docs patch for the JS SDK streaming change in v2. The old callback pattern is being removed and folks hitting node 14/16 show confusing stack traces. I sketched a migration snippet and a short note for the migration guide: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/migration/js-streaming. PR incoming.
sam: Can you paste the snippet here? I want to sanity-check the code examples for both browser and node runtimes.
maya: Sure — current v1 pattern we have in examples:

```js
// v1 (callback style)
client.stream({model: 'rw-v1'}, (chunk) => {
  console.log(chunk.text)
})
```

New v2 recommended pattern is async iterator:

```js
// v2 (async iterator)
for await (const chunk of client.stream({model: 'rw-v2'})) {
  console.log(chunk.text)
}
```

But the gotcha: in node <=16 the iteration errors surface as "TypeError: stream is not async iterable" for users still on old SDKs or polyfills. We should doc the exact error and give a small compatibility shim and a migration checklist.
kevin: Agree. Also need to update the snippet that shows how to close streams on client shutdown — some OSS code relied on `stream.cancel()` which we removed. Suggest adding the replacement pattern with `break` + `client.waitForClose()`.
anita: I can grab this in a short PR. Suggest adding a short Troubleshooting section with exact error strings so search results point to it. Example entry:

- Error: "TypeError: stream is not async iterable" — likely running old runtime or old SDK. Upgrade to SDK >=2.1.0 or use the shim below.
chris: Pinged infra to add a smoke test in the docs CI to run the snippet under node 14/16/18 and fail if the example throws. Otherwise we keep shipping broken examples.
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 — includes snippet rewrites, troubleshooting entry, and a tiny redirect from /v1-js-streaming to /v2-streaming. Still need owners to review and confirm wording for "breaking" vs "behavioral change".
sam: I'll review. Two comments: 1) change the browser example to use `ReadableStreamDefaultReader` for streaming fetch wrappers, 2) add an inline note about long-poll fallbacks if network drops.
kevin: For the compatibility shim, propose adding this short helper (add under "If you can't upgrade immediately"):

```js
// async-iterable shim for old envs
async function* shimAsyncIterable(promiseMaker) {
  const p = promiseMaker()
  while (true) {
    const r = await p.next()
    if (r.done) return
    yield r.value
  }
}
```

But that looks weird. Maybe simpler to recommend `npm install --save core-js` or just suggest Node >= 18.
anita: Let's be explicit: "Recommended: upgrade to Node >= 18 or use SDK >= 2.1.0. If you cannot, add this minimal polyfill ..." Include the small shim but mark as last-resort.
chris: Added a CI task in the docs repo: `.github/workflows/snippet-smoke.yml` that runs node 16/18 and executes the examples. Linking the CI run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/987654321
maya: One more thing — outreach: product wants a short blurb for release notes and a suggested customer-facing sentence for the deprecation email. Draft: "Streaming callbacks in the JS SDK are replaced by async iterators in v2. Please update examples; see migration guide." Can someone refine that copy?
sam: Draft looks fine. Maybe add severity: low breaking (only affects callback-style stream hooks).
anita: I'll add a short migration checklist at top of doc:

- Confirm SDK version >= 2.1.0
- Update examples from callback -> async iterator
- Run snippet smoke tests under node 16/18
- Add redirect from old URL to new guide
- Add troubleshooting entry with exact error strings

maya: Perfect. @docs-bot can you create a redirect ticket in our tracker and add the docs PR to the "deprecation" column?
docs-bot: Created ticket DOCS-789 in backlog and added PR #5123 to column "deprecation-migrations". :white_check_mark:
chris: Two final asks: add a note about cloud-hosted examples (Hosted API) vs private deploys (behavior identical, but include a note on older private images that may ship older runtime). And ensure we don't mention internal-only flags in public docs.
maya: Agreed — added a short sentence in the PR. Thanks everyone. I'll merge once sam + kevin approve and CI passes. :rocket:
sam: Reviewing now.
kevin: LGTM pending a tiny wording tweak on the shim note.
maya: Merged in staging, will schedule a docs-backport to stable once we confirm CI across node versions. Closing thread after merge notes posted in #release-war-room.
